description: Implementation of the ProgramNULL class methods for the ANGLE project, providing stub functions for shader program management in a null renderer context.

classes.name: ProgramNULL
classes.description: A null implementation of a shader program used in the ANGLE graphics library.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a link event, always returns a continue event.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves program state to a stream (no-op).

methods.name: setBinaryRetrievableHint
methods.description: Sets whether the binary is retrievable (no-op).

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links the program, always returns a continue event.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the program, always returns true.

methods.name: setUniform*
methods.description: Set uniform variables of various types (no-op).
